prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Keep Your Pets Safe Across Sign-Ins", "Connecting your account ensures your companion and all unlocked items are safely stored in the cloud.", "Cloud Save Active"]
1: ["Bringing Your Desktop Pet To Life", "We are preparing your companion's graphics and animations for your desktop view.", "Initializing Desktop Renderer..."]
2: ["Customize Companion Sound Effects", "Choose sound effects and voice pitch for your pet before adoption.", "Test Greeting Sound"]
3: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Scroll to discover how your desktop pet lives alongside your daily workflow."]
4: ["How to Summon and Control Your Pet", "Press Alt+Pet shortcut or right-click the system tray icon anytime to interact with your pet.", "Alt+P to open menu; Right-click tray to manage settings"]
5: ["Step 1/3: Loading desktop overlay window...", "Step 2/3: Applying companion animations..."]
6: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data", "Your companion stays saved to your account even if you log out or switch devices."]
7: ["Use a clear, well-lit photo with a visible face for best custom pet generation results."]
8: ["We will alert you as soon as your desktop pet is ready to play!"]
9: ["Bonus Unlocked: Free Desktop Bowtie"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requiring a clear photo of a face.
